svg.title: Coastal Wind 35 — Construction Details
svg.text: Keel/Bulb | Saildrive | Bow Thruster | Mast Step | Chainplate | Midship Section
• Torque keel bolts to 350 N·m in cross pattern. Re-torque after 24h.
• Inspect keel bolt countersunk recesses for corrosion every 3 years.
• Apply Sikaflex 291 generously — squeeze-out confirms full coverage.
SAILDRIVE SPECS: Oceanvolt AXC 15 or ServoProp 15
Opening Ø200mm, centred at x=6800mm from FP
Propeller centreline: approx. 800mm below hull baseline
MUST remain submerged at 35° heel — verified ✓
Position: x=700mm from FP. Tunnel must be FAIRED FLUSH.
Sidepower SP55 / Lewmar BTe 120 or equivalent.
SCALE BARS: Details 1–2 @ 1:10; Details 3 @ 1:5; Details 4–5 @ 1:10; Detail 6 @ 1:15
All GRP laminates: vinylester resin preferred. Keel bolts: M36 Aquamet 22 SS. Saildrive rubber bellows: annual inspection mandatory. Lead ballast: keel 600kg steel fin + 2400kg lead bulb.
